text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fiery three years of chasing a "dream" 
with Bamboo Memory have finally come to an 
endâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Yet, deep within her heart, a new 'dream' 
is already burning bright."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As long as that passion remains, her days 
of challenging herself will never end—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Good morning!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on the Way to School A
text_block_list.text: Good morning~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on the Way to School B
text_block_list.text:
Morning, Madam Disciplinary Committee 
Chair~

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Mhm, mhm! Everyone's full of energy, 
public morals are well-kept, and it's a 
great morning, sir!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: U-Um! Bamboo Memory-senpai! Good morning!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
GOOD MORNING! What a splendid greeting!! 
Let's give it our all today as well!!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Um. Senpai, do you have a moment to 
talk?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Mmh, of course, no problem! Are you in 
some kind of trouble? Is it a disciplinary 
issue!?

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Um... well...—

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I...! Want to join the Disciplinary 
Committee!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
No way, seriously!? Of course, you are 
super-duper welcome! You've finally 
realized the nobility of upholding public 
morals!!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I mean, of course that's part of it, 
but... Well, the truth is... I really look 
up to you, Bamboo-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Watching your race, Bamboo-senpai, my 
heart felt so fired up... It was pounding 
so hard...!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I want to run like that... I want to 
become cool, just like Bamboo-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
And so, I thought if I joined the 
Disciplinary Committee, I might be able to 
get a little closer to Bamboo-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...Once I finally debut and get super, 
super strong, I... I want to run in a race 
against Bamboo-senpai...!"

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: That is my "dream"!!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ain't that a great "dream" now, huh~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—And that's what happened! I was just so 
moved...!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Because saying running in a race with me 
is your "dream"... that's just...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
How can I not cry at something like this, 
dammit?! UWOOOOOOOOOOOH!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yes, sir!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All of this is... because you've been 
right by my side cheering on my "dream," 
Trainer-san!!
choice_data_list:
Because you're the one who let me see that 
"dream."

Because you're the one who showed me that 
"dream."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Heheh—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—For her "dream," and for my own "dream" 
too! I gotta become an even more awesome 
Umamusume, yeah?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Please continue to guide me with all your 
passion and discipline!!!
